candidates_described.name: cnn1d
candidates_described.notes: 1-D CNN over the 128-bin mel spectrum from the locked feature vector: two strided convolutions with batch norm, adaptive average pooling, linear head. Frequency-translation equivariance is the inductive bias this model is here to test.

candidates_described.name: crnn
candidates_described.notes: Convolutional front-end feeding a bidirectional GRU over the frequency axis with recurrent pooling (first + last state).  Tests whether the ORDER of frequency bins carries signal a purely local receptive field misses.

candidates_described.name: transfer
candidates_described.notes: Transfer learning: frozen ImageNet-pretrained MobileNetV3Small backbone, new head trained on our mel spectra.  The 128-bin spectrum is upsampled to 96x96, which loses information; the comparison table shows whether reused filters beat the from-scratch CNNs anyway.  Requires the cached pretrained weights -- no network access at train or inference time.

selection.rationale: selected crnn[channels=32,epochs=60,hidden=96] on validation macro_f1=0.6531 (val accuracy 0.6511, critical recall 0.7022) out of 8 trials; test split not used for selection. no candidate met the critical-recall floor of 0.85; selecting the best available on macro-F1 and flagging this in the report
